reason: You don't tell me who the payment partner is, what the fee per transaction is, or when the money lands in my account, and that's the first thing I need to know. I might take the free listing, but I'm not putting QR codes on my tables until I see those numbers.
objection: An unnamed payment company charging a fee you don't state, on top of my bank terminal fee, and I don't know how many days my cash is held. On my margins, half a percent extra and a two-day delay hurt more than 59 lari.
would_change_my_mind: A named Georgian bank as the partner, a per-transaction fee at or below my current terminal fee, and money in my account next day. Then I'd try the 3 free months.
